_comment: Single source for the 'Comparing backup vendors?' note on backup-vendor connector pages. backup_vendor_note.py renders it into docs/skills/<slug>.md (through render_docs_page.py) and into a marker block in skills/<slug>/README.md. Edit the text here only; then run `python3 tools/maintainer/backup_vendor_note.py --write` and `python3 tools/maintainer/build-catalog.py`. Onboarding (msp-skills-publish) should read this same file rather than carry its own copy, so a new backup connector gets the note with no second source of the text.

applies_to._comment: A connector gets the note when its registry category is listed here, or its slug is in extra_slugs (a vendor that sells backup whose connector is filed under another category, e.g. NinjaOne Backup inside an RMM connector). first_party connectors (Servosity) and markdown-only skills never get it.

label: Comparing backup vendors?
body: One of our MSP partners told us, "My guys now spend a tenth of the time on backups." Fixing is included in every Servosity co-managed backup plan, and our engineers tell you what they did.
